description: Source code for the UnboundHandler class, which manages API interactions with the Unbound AI service, including model fetching, message creation, and prompt completion.

classes.name: UnboundHandler
classes.description: A class that extends RouterProvider to handle API requests to Unbound AI, including model management and message streaming.

methods.name: fetchModel
methods.description: Fetches available models from the Unbound API and updates internal state.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model configuration, including ID and info.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming message to the Unbound API, yielding response chunks and usage data.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the Unbound API and returns the generated text.
